articles.title: The Carlton Walker Chronicles: Dispelling a Myth of Martyrdom
articles.summary: Detailed investigation referencing the 170-page Amended Final Order in case 2019-DR-10-1147, with court findings of manipulation, deception, threats, coercion, and abuse over years. Court reportedly stated child wants no contact with Walker or his parents.
articles.keyQuote: The Court has said openly that the child wants nothing to do with Carlton or his parents.

articles.title: The Carlton Walker Chronicles II: You're a Bad Daddy
articles.summary: Follow-up investigation citing court recognition of psychological and emotional abuse of a child. References psychological evaluation and details around stepfather James Romero who was charged with six counts of sexual exploitation of a minor.
articles.keyQuote: What Carlton paints as righteous outrage, the Court recognized as the psychological and emotional abuse of a child.

articles.title: Carlton Walker Sued By The Mother of His Child For Fraud & Dodging Child Support
articles.summary: Reports on May 2023 complaint filed by Sylvia Ashley McAdams via Hopkins Law Firm alleging fraud and asset-hiding scheme. Walker reportedly owed more than $40,000 in fees. Allegations include parents complicit in scheme, taking property from Walker for token sums.
articles.keyQuote: According to the complaint, this wasn't just Carlton's typically sloppy bookkeeping, but an intentional scheme.

articles.title: Carlton Walker: The Artificially Intelligent Candidate For SC House of Representatives
articles.summary: Investigation into Walker's use of AI-generated images in his campaign. Notes he previously littered Berkeley County with handmade signs before moving to Charleston County. Connects his political run to his prior attorney Rep. Gil Gatch.
articles.keyQuote: Walker Was Confronted For His Attempts To Pass Off AI Generated Images As Authentic.

articles.title: Watch: Lowcountry House Candidate Campaigns on Family Court Reform
articles.summary: Interview-format coverage of Walker's family court reform platform. Provides background that he decided to run for office after experiencing what he described as unfair treatment during a child custody case.
articles.keyQuote: Walker is now a residential builder, having previously worked as a skilled laborer.

articles.title: SC House candidate claims yard sign was taken by someone associated with his opponent
articles.summary: Local news coverage of Walker's claim that a campaign sign on Red Bank Road was removed. Berkeley County Sheriff's Office turned investigation over to SLED.

articles.title: Republican Carlton Walker announces run for South Carolina House District 15
articles.summary: Initial candidacy announcement coverage. Notes Walker is broker-in-charge with We Love Real Estate Company, contractor with Hurry Up Handyman, SLED-certified concealed weapons instructor, and 4th generation Veteran.
articles.keyQuote: Walker is a broker in charge with the We Love Real Estate Company.

articles.title: Man jailed over grass, trees
articles.summary: Reports North Charleston mobile home park owner Carlton Walker spent a night in jail for a string of tickets including allowing grass to grow. Has been fined thousands of dollars by the City of North Charleston for cutting and trimming trees near his home.
articles.keyQuote: Spent a night in jail earlier this month for a string of tickets.

articles.title: Rep Gil Gatch: Consistently Inconsistent on Judges
articles.summary: Reports on connection between Rep. Gil Gatch and Walker family, noting Gatch represented Walker family in family court case. References Judge Daniel Martin presiding.
articles.keyQuote: The Carlton Walker family had previously been represented by Gatch in his family court debacle.

articles.title: Republicans sweep Berkeley County in high-turnout election
articles.summary: Coverage of 2024 general election results. JA Moore defeated Carlton Walker by 250 votes in House District 15 race.
articles.keyQuote: JA Moore squeaked by Republican challenger Carlton Walker by 250 votes.

articles.title: VIDEO: Meet the Candidates: SC House District 15: Carlton Walker
articles.summary: Candidate profile video interview from local Charleston station.

articles.title: Lowcountry incumbents win big in Statehouse primary races
articles.summary: Coverage of June 2024 primary races. Notes Walker advanced from canceled Republican primary to face JA Moore.

articles.title: 2024 Election Guide: Charleston County Races
articles.summary: Election guide listing District 15 candidates including Walker.

articles.title: Carlton Walker - Ballotpedia Profile
articles.summary: Reference profile noting Walker did not complete Ballotpedia's 2024 Candidate Connection survey. Lists campaign finance data.

articles.summary: Campaign finance reference data for 2024 election cycle.
